messages:
maya: quick plan check for the launch-nurture sequence tied to the May benchmark webinar + new product announcement. want a 4-email stack: invite, reminder, launch highlight, playbook download. targeted segs: engaged trialers, newsletter opens (last 90d), and inbound leads.
sam: counts? we need to size for throttling and SDR capacity.
luc: pulled numbers this am: engaged trialers=1,320; newsletter opens=12,450; inbound leads=620. after suppressions ~12k.
harper: smart routing idea: send initial invite across all, but route inbound leads + any org with >30 employees to SDR immediately if they open + click. others go into nurture.
maya: cadence proposal:
```
Day 0: invite + quick value prop (webinar invite + beta launch note)
Day 2: reminder + 1-sentence case highlight
Day 5: product launch email (top features + short gif)
Day 10: playbook download + 1-question pulse survey
```
sam: A/B subject test for invite: A) "Live: New inference benchmark + product demo" B) "See the benchmark & how we cut inference cost"
luc: avoid unverified claims in subject. B could be: "See the benchmark & cost playbook"
harper: tracking keys: utm_campaign=may_launch_nurture, utm_source=email, utm_medium=drip, utm_content=variantA|variantB. also capture header for upstream attribution (X-Redwood-Mail).
maya: suppression rules: exclude anyone emailed last 10 days + unsub list + bounced. waitlist customers should be excluded from the promo but get a dedicated note.
sam: ESP throttling limit = 2,500/hr. add priority queue for SDR routes so high-value opens skip batching.
luc: personalization tokens: {{first_name}}, {{company_size}}, {{last_login_days}}. dynamic CTA: "Request a demo" vs "Download playbook" depending on company_size>50.
harper: analytics plan: open vs click by segment, playbook downloads, webinar RSVPs, downstream SQL demos. jeff from analytics to own funnel dashboards.
maya: copy review flow: sam drafts email bodies -> harper QA links/assets -> maya approves -> mailer-bot schedules.
mailer-bot: draft created: "may_launch_nurture_v1" queued at 1728345799.
sam: can we include a 1-question survey in email 4 for why they didn't convert? options: "cost", "timing", "not relevant", "other". keep optional.
luc: yes, and feed responses to product for quick feedback.
maya: final ask 1: ensure GDPR localized footer for EU segment and time-window adjustments for APAC sends. will post final counts and scheduled UTC send windows here within 12h. :rocket:
